name: After § 46
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Türkiye
part_text: 46a. Regrets that, in 2024, the Turkish Government adopted legislative changes that led to the mass killing of stray animals, especially stray dogs whose estimated population is up to 4 million; expresses serious concern for animal welfare standards in Türkiye and calls on the Turkish authorities to significantly improve and guarantee better animal welfare standards;
